text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain deferred P3 complete-workflow acceptance, not obsolete or already satisfied by ingestion. Current WorkflowIngestAcceptanceSuite and BIDS/preflight tests cover earlier boundaries; the complete persisted group execution and resumable orchestration remain open. Keep one end-to-end scenario over actual pinned estimate artifacts rather than the old ResultManifest/catalog facade; assert scientific identities and explicit comparison contracts across all stages. Do not infer registration from normalized naming or affine equality; fixture alignment is known construction and real input admission remains explicit. Separate JVM physical/compressed IO from shared portable numerical/orchestration contracts, require real fresh-process resume and failed-publication tests, and measure response payload plus relevant metadata/read buffers. Small fixture agreement alone cannot certify full-study memory scaling. This remains a final integration gate after core pieces, not a prerequisite for fixing them; no new scenario run here.
